name: Toggl Track
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Toggl Track, track time quickly, edit entries, and report by project, client, and tag. The hard boundary is cross-platform apps, background tracking, integrations, team controls, and sync, plus ubiquitous capture, coaching, and team workflow.
